assumptions.choice: First 4 bars (60 minutes) of each calendar day form the opening range high/low; entry signals are evaluated starting on bar 5.
assumptions.reason: The opening range high and low cannot be finalized until all 4 initial 15-minute bars complete.

assumptions.choice: Place a Backtrader StopTrail order upon completion of entry order with trailamount set to 1.5 * ATR(14) at execution time.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader StopTrail orders manage trailing stops as separate orders linked to existing position size.

assumptions.choice: Filter trading signals to timestamps between 09:30 and 16:00 inclusive.
assumptions.reason: Specification mandates ignoring signals outside regular market hours.

assumptions.choice: Close current position via self.close() when an opposite breakout signal occurs, without immediately reversing into a new position on the same bar.
assumptions.reason: Ensures adherence to the single position constraint and default exit pattern.
